payload.core_mechanism_summary: Normalizes numbers by left-shifting to same bit-length, computes bitmask to separate common prefix from variable suffix, counts suffix bit-length occurrences, then uses cumulative sums to find min operations.
payload.rationale: The solution relies entirely on binary representation manipulation and bitwise operations, not on greedy choices or exhaustive search. No exchange arguments or two-pointer techniques are used, making bit_binary_representation the most accurate subtype.
